Today, BitGo and @galaxyhq have come together to provide clients with more flexibility in how they utilize their staked assets.

With this strategic partnership clients can now stake their assets with Galaxy with the ability to use them for financing. This leverages BitGo’s secure tri-party collateral management offering built on the strength of our regulated cold storage offering.

As the largest independent qualified custodian with over $100B in assets under custody, BitGo is dedicated to ensuring our clients can pursue growth opportunities with increased flexibility and maximum capital efficiency.

"As our institutional clients look for solutions beyond custody we continue to expand our offerings which include staking, tri-party collateral management and financing.  We believe working with Galaxy will allow our clients to efficiently custody, stake, and finance their digital asset strategies," said Adam Sporn, Head of Prime Brokerage and US Institutional Sales at BitGo.
